key_finding:
Composite router with cost-aware per-node decisions matches the previously-known-best outcome (above_median) on leaf-classification at $10.50 — versus X204's $43.24 with opus-everywhere + max_nodes=16 + num_designs=8 (4x the cost for same outcome bucket).

The earlier policy.json comment 'leaf-classification — bigger search did not bridge to bronze' is now reinforced: bronze is genuinely unreachable here at any model/search config tested. The cheaper router path is therefore strictly preferred for this task — same outcome at 25% the cost.
strategic_validation: The L58/L59 budget-cap failure motivated the strategic pivot to --designs 1 --nodes 4 --budget 15 (3h cap). L60 ran fully to completion under this config in 1h40, with aggregator finishing well within budget. Pivot validated.

scorecard_final.L60_leaf_classification_scout: above_median ($10.50, safer budget worked) n=1 KNOWN

campaign_synthesis.main_finding: The composite agentic router (Static→LLM mode=stable) achieves competitive-or-better outcomes vs opus-everywhere at substantially lower cost when (a) the per-node budget allows aggregator completion, and (b) the conda env has the libraries the agent's code chooses (yaml, timm, lightgbm).
campaign_synthesis.generalization_signal: Across 7 valid-submission scouts: 3 medals (43% medal rate, including 1 GOLD-confirmed at n=2). Cost range $10.50 to $31.79. Compare to prior data where opus-everywhere costs $40+ for similar/worse outcomes.
failure_modes_observed: env-gap (40% of failed nodes): conda env missing yaml/timm/lightgbm — agent's reasonable code choices crash at import
budget-cap (2 of 10 runs): at --nodes 6 --budget 10 (2h pipeline cap), opus-heavy router decisions consume budget before aggregator runs
data-prep (1 of 10): val_inputs/ empty on disk for histopathologic-cancer-detection
policy_recommendations: Do NOT update policy.json this campaign — single-task n=2 GOLD confirmation is not enough to lock a family default. Two more image-natural tasks at n=1 each would warrant promotion.
For future campaigns: pre-install yaml/timm/lightgbm into rl env to remove the env-gap confound.
For known-hard text tasks (spooky-author, jigsaw): use --budget 20+ to give opus-escalated routing aggregator room.
